def test_is_bored():
    # Basic cases
    assert is_bored("Hello world") == 0
    assert is_bored("The sky is blue. The sun is shining. I love this weather") == 1
    assert is_bored("I love it") == 1

    # Multiple boredoms across sentences
    assert is_bored("I feel bored. I want to sleep. You are fine.") == 2

    # Delimiters: . ? !
    assert is_bored("I am bored? I am sleepy! I am hungry.") == 3

    # "Is" and "It" must NOT count â only "I " as first word
    assert is_bored("Is the sky blue? It is.") == 0

    # Empty and edge cases
    assert is_bored("") == 0
    assert is_bored("I") == 0          # single "I" with no following word/space
    assert is_bored("I love it.") == 1  # trailing delimiter is fine

    # Leading/trailing whitespace
    assert is_bored("  I am tired.") == 1

    print("All tests passed!")


test_is_bored()
